title: Orient recommends bee-wayfinding when a map has frontier and work is idle
action: In build_orient (orient.rs:298): when the discovery scan (wf-2) finds at least one map with frontier tickets AND the pipeline is idle — no open/claimed cells, no pending handoff, phase terminal or lane idle (derive idleness from the fields build_orient already reads; keep the predicate in one named helper so the condition is testable) — set next.skill to 'bee-wayfinding' (overriding the ORIENT_PHASE_SKILL lookup at orient.rs:471-481), set next.command to 'bee discovery list --json', and set next.action to a one-line resume recommendation naming the map. When work is active, add only a report-only blockers[] line ('open discovery map <name> — N frontier') following the capture-queue blocker shape at orient.rs:354-365, and leave next untouched. Tests both ways per the plan matrix: fires when idle with frontier; silent (blocker line only) mid-feature; silent when frontier is zero. Run cargo test for touched suites; commit.

truths: orient returns skill=bee-wayfinding only in the idle+frontier case, never while cells are open or claimed

artifacts.substantive: named idle+frontier predicate plus next/blockers wiring

key_links: next.command points at bee discovery list --json
prohibitions: Never override next while a handoff is pending — the handoff rule wins

trace.outcome: orient recommends bee-wayfinding when idle with open frontier tickets; report-only blocker mid-feature
